title: Parchment dispenser
text: Parchment dispenser. I have the big box parchment roll and it fits perfectly, however - it COMES WITH a roll of brown (unbleached) parchment paper.  I was disappointed that the box is covered with a contact paper/or like instead of real bamboo.  Eh.  It is a drawer dispenser and cannot be mounted.  Partially because of the way you dispense the paper.  Hard to describe but you don't pull the paper though the top slot. You open the top and pull out, close the top and slide the cutter over the top.  I am happy it fits in the drawer, was thinking I would be able to use in the drawer - but you do have to remove the box and set on the counter to use - at least the way my drawers are.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  Further, my reviews are always based on my personal experience and honest.  Your experience may be different.  I am never compensated for my reviews.  I accept only discounts that are available to all shoppers.
